$comment: Ratchet for tools/validate-family-readability.mjs. `ceiling` is the number of family-facing English strings (see tools/lib/family-readability.mjs) of minWords words or more whose Flesch-Kincaid grade (fleschKincaid in tools/lib/copy-scan.mjs) is above `threshold`. It may only go down: lower it in the same commit that simplifies a string, never raise it. Strings under minWords words are judged by eye, because one technical term in a short sentence is a known false positive of grade formulas.
